packageRules.description: Example stacks and the endpoint-discovery helper are not shipped dependencies
Pin Dockerfile base image digests. Debian is part of the distroless image name (static-debian13), so a later Debian does not arrive as a version bump.
Automerge Dockerfile digest and non-major updates when checks pass
Automerge Go toolchain updates, including majors, when checks pass
Automerge non-major Go module updates when checks pass
Automerge GitHub Actions and reusable workflow references, including majors, when checks pass. Action inputs such as the golangci-lint version are separate dependencies.
Ignore golangci-lint pre-releases. Renovate reads the action's version input itself.
Automerge golangci-lint v2 minor bumps when lint passes. Leave a v3 PR open.
package_cloud publishes on Ruby 4.0. The release workflow does not run on pull requests, so review Ruby version updates.
